Remark
[Normal curvature and Ricci equations]

Source: petersen:page-0123 ↗ def:pet-ch3-second-fundamental-form

1. ch3:3.4.14For tangent fields $X,Y$ and normal fields $V,W$ of a submanifold, define the normal curvature $R^\perp (X,Y,V,W)$. (1) Show $R^\perp $ is tensorial and skew-symmetric in $X,Y$ and in $V,W$. (2) Show $R^{\bar M}(X,Y,V,W)=R^\perp (X,Y,V,W)+g_M(T_XV,T_YW)-g_M(T_YV,T_XW)$ (the Ricci equations).
